ios.desc:
Divergent is a simple yet powerful app to help you keep up with your day-to-day tasks. From hardcore reminders to an awesome upcoming tab, get more done with less mental effort and overwhelming stress.

Do you struggle to keep track of all the tasks you need to complete on a daily basis? Do you feel like you're constantly forgetting important deadlines or appointments? If so, our innovative and intuitive app is the solution you've been looking for.

Our app is designed to help you stay on top of your to-do list and ensure that nothing falls through the cracks. With a sleek and modern interface, you can easily view all your upcoming tasks, along with any tasks that are overdue. You can also set reminders up to 7 reminders for each task, so you'll never forget to complete something important.

But that's just the beginning – our app is packed with features that make it the ultimate productivity tool for your busy life. For starters, you can create lists to organize your tasks by project, category, or any other criteria that are important to you. You can even add tags to your tasks, making it easy to filter and sort them by keyword.

Our app also includes a powerful search function, so you can quickly find any task, list, or tag with just a few taps.

So why wait? Download Divergent today and start taking control of your busy life!
